definition: one hundredth of a unit of money
description: A small café with pale wooden walls. A young woman with long red curly hair in a blue top tips a big glass jar full of copper coins onto the wooden counter, and the small coins pour out into a pile. Behind the counter a white goat in a green apron stands on its hind legs holding a wooden spatula, looks at the pile and then turns to her, and she smiles at it. A paper coffee cup, cinnamon buns under a glass dome, a coffee machine, mugs on a shelf and a plant are around them.

taps.phrase: to empty a jar of coins
